name: Triumph Tiger 1050 / Tiger Explorer 1200
engine: 1050 cc triple (Tiger 1050, chain) or 1215 cc triple (Explorer and Tiger 1200, shaft), liquid-cooled, fuel injected
intro: Triumph's big triples. The Tiger 1050 is a road bike with a chain, the Explorer and Tiger 1200 have shaft drive.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2012-2014 Tiger Explorers are in recall 14V009 (throttle signal can shut the engine down). 2018-2020 Tiger 1200s are in recall 20V236 (front brake pads may corrode and lose their friction material).
A-002.reason: An engine shutdown or failing pads is a crash risk. Both fixes are free.

E: The Tiger 1050 has a chain. The Explorer and Tiger 1200 have shaft drive. Skip the steps that don't match.

recalls.what: Throttle position signal fault can shut the engine down.
Front brake pads may corrode and the friction material can come off the backing plate.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the front pads free.
